title: Cucumber Pachadi
description: A cooling yogurt-based salad of grated cucumber folded with a light coconut-mustard tempering — a refreshing counterpoint to a spicy South Indian meal.
steps: Grind the grated coconut, green chilli and cumin seeds with a splash of water into a smooth paste.
In a bowl, combine the whisked curd, grated cucumber, coconut paste and salt. Mix well.
For the tempering, heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the curry leaves and dried red chilli, letting them sizzle for a few seconds.
Pour the tempering over the pachadi and mix gently. Chill briefly before serving alongside rice and curry.
